proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our rowhome basement steps are steep and narrow, and two other companies said the washer would have to come upstairs. Their tech changed the pump right there with a headlamp and a stack of towels.
reviews.name: Danielle P.

reviews.text: I tried the repair-or-replace tool before calling and it said borderline for our 9-year-old dishwasher. The tech agreed, fixed the drain pump, and wrote down what to watch for next.
reviews.name: Victor R.

reviews.text: Range clicking nonstop after I mopped the stovetop. Water in the spark switch. He dried it out, tested every burner and charged only the visit. Felt like a neighbor, not a pitch.
reviews.name: Mei C.

reviews.text: They told me over the phone where the model tag on my dryer was hiding, inside the door frame on the left. The tech came with the right heating element and was gone in under an hour.
reviews.name: Frank D.

reviews.text: Microwave over the stove hummed and did nothing. They priced the part, then pointed out a new one would cost about the same, and mounted the one we bought ourselves.
reviews.name: Aisha N.

reviews.text: Ice maker quit and the water line behind the fridge had been kinked since we slid it back after painting. A small fix, but nobody else had bothered to pull the fridge out and look.
reviews.name: Colin J.

proof.guarantee: Repairs covered for 90 days on parts and labor. Same part fails, we come back.
